newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil cenbank bond rate drops to 2.6385 pct.
newsitem.headline: Brazil cenbank bond rate drops to 2.6385 pct.

text.p: Brazil's benchmark overnight rate dropped to 2.6385 percent a month at today's 5.319 billion reais sale of 56-day Central Bank Bonds (BBC) from from 2.687 percent at the previous auction, dealers said.
The result was in line with market expectations, they added.
The Central Bank held its weekly BBC auction today due to the four-day Carnival holiday, starting Saturday. The Central Bank usually sets the bonds auctions on Tuesdays.
The 56-day bonds will mature on April 9. Today's auction is expected to add 1.181 billion reais to the banking system, with 6.5 billion reais in old bonds coming due Wednesday.
